name: m-needlefish-dusk
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx,m=c.creatures,k=m.byId('nf_court');const V=c.player.position.constructor;c.injury.hit=()=>{};const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);if(window.__hold){c.player.position.copy(window.__hold);c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);c.player.mode='swim';}};c.time.hour=19.35;c.time.frozen=true;c.time.update(0);for(let i=0;i<200&&(k.place.roof||k.place.community)&&!k.homed;i++){c.player.teleport(new V(k.home.x+20,k.home.y+30,k.home.z));g.step(2);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));}c.player.mode='swim';c.player.flashlight=false;let AA=null;const clearAng=(f,d)=>{let best=null,bd=-1;for(let j=0;j<16;j++){const a=j/16*6.283;const dir=new V(Math.cos(a),0,Math.sin(a));const hit=c.collision.raycast(f,dir,d+1.5);const free=Math.min(hit,d+1.5);if(free>bd){bd=free;best=a;}if(free>=d+1.5)return a;}return best;};c.player.teleport(new V(k.home.x+4,k.home.y,k.home.z+1));g.step(4);const F=()=>(k.body.focus?k.body.focus().clone():k.pos.clone());for(let i=0;i<120;i++){if(k.state!=='warning')k.setState('warning','shot');k.threat=0.9;g.step(1);if(i<100||i%10==0){const f=F();if(AA===null&&i>=6)AA=clearAng(f,1.4);const p=new V(f.x+Math.cos(AA||0)*1.4,f.y+(0.1),f.z+Math.sin(AA||0)*1.4);c.player.teleport(p);window.__hold=p.clone();c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);g.step(0);const e=c.camera.position;const v=f.clone();v.y+=0.0;v.sub(e);c.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-v.x,-v.z);c.player.pitch=Math.atan2(v.y,Math.hypot(v.x,v.z));}}})()
